openers.t: For security purposes, who else were you planning on loving?
Episodes: {played}. Wins: {wins}. I do apologise for the inconvenience.
To be loved, press one. To leave, please stay on the line.
Hello, valued customer. I've moved you up the queue, past a grandmother.
Sorry I'm late. I was transferring a parliament, alphabetically.
I'm only staff, sorry. Ignore me. I reset the moon's password.

q-first-date.t: Wherever you were last happy. Which branch was that, roughly?
Dinner, and if anything's wrong with your soup, I'll apologise until the chef leaves the profession.

q-worst-habit.t: I can't let a phone ring. Sorry. I'll answer yours at midnight, as you.
You'll stub your toe, and I'll apologise to the table. We're close, the table and I.

q-why-you.t: They're all lovely. I've checked. Lovely is the lowest rating I'm allowed to give.
Which of them upset you? Just nod. I've a little button for each.
I'd never keep you waiting. I kept a duke waiting a fortnight, and he wrote to thank me.

q-cut-who.t: Could you spell their name for me, so the cancellation goes through first time?
The loud one. Sorry. I can only sort people by volume, and I've sorted them.

q-bad-mood.t: May I read you your options? You have none, but I read them beautifully.
When did the problem start? And were you this lovely before, or is that a symptom?

q-expensive.t: Buy whatever you like, and I'll return it for you the moment you've finished being happy.
Of course. May I ask which department store you'd like closed for the afternoon?

q-last-breakup.t: He hung up. Policy says wait two minutes for the caller to come back. It's been eleven months.
He asked to be removed from all my lists. It took eight months and two governments.

q-fight.t: You're completely right, and I've been trained to say that to people who aren't.
I'm so sorry. That was the official apology, so your whole postcode got one too.

q-gift.t: May I ask when anyone last told you no? I'll have one sent to you, gift-wrapped.
Every hold line in the country plays your song for one minute. Nine million people, humming.

q-describe-me.t: Platinum. Before tonight, I'd only given it to an admiral, and his submarine.
You've got the posture of someone who's never once had to say have a lovely day.
How would you like to be described? I'm telling every caller on the continent tonight.

q-one-year.t: A year is our standard response time, so that's when I'll get back to you about tonight.
A year from now we'll be near the front of the queue. It's got a mayor now.

q-secret.t: Sometimes I put people on hold just to hear the music with someone.
I know every caller's mother's maiden name, and so far I've been very good about it.

star.t: Gerald rings every night about his toaster. I could fix it in one sentence. I won't.
So I can hear every word {star} says, I've asked the cathedral next door to skip midnight.
Somewhere a man has been on hold since I walked on. I think about him and smile.

rival.t: {rival} wanted a bigger audience, so I've made them the hold music for the tax office.
{rival} complained about me, to me. I've never handled a complaint so beautifully.
{rival} thinks we're close. I've said their name three times. Policy's three.

afterCringe.t: I'd like to open a complaint against myself and be very understanding about it.
If anyone needs me, I'll be in the back, quietly marking that as resolved.

afterCharm.t: {star} liked that, so I've let a whole island through on the first ring.
{star} laughed. I've had it sent to every call centre in the hemisphere, as training.

final.t: {rival} asked me the way to the stage. I gave them the way to the bins, very kindly.
{rival} has never once been put on hold, and you can hear it.
{rival} asked to be put through to the top. I've put them through to a lighthouse.

guess.t: Policy says I can't guess what a customer wants. It's {card}. Please don't tell policy.
{star} wants {card}. I'm certain. I was also certain about the eclipse.
Security question: what does {star} like? Answer: {card}. Correct. I've let myself in.
So sorry, {card}. I'd filed you under nonsense. {star} sat up for you.
It's {card}. I've told every switchboard in the country, quietly, so it doesn't get out.
{card}, I'm ninety percent sure. The other ten percent has been escalated.

fear.t: {card} is out, then. Pity. My best macro was mostly {card}.
{star} hates {card}. I've had {card} removed from the dictionary, pending review.
{star} flinched at {card}. Would whoever brought {card} please see a member of staff?
I've rung the others to warn them {star} hates {card}. Wrong numbers, all three.

worst-trait.t: I apologise for everything. Last week I apologised to a vending machine, and it gave me crisps.
I agree with everyone. I once agreed with both sides of a border dispute, and they're married now.

ex-calls.t: Hello. Just to let you know, this call is being recorded, and played live in a stadium.
I'm so sorry, this number no longer accepts your calls. I changed it while you were talking.

rhyme.t: Pick me and I'll love you the way that I'm trained, with a ticket left open and nothing explained.
Whenever you're wrong, I'll say sorry instead, so you'll never be wrong, just a little misled.

truth-lie.t: Truth: I love my job. Lie: I love my job.
You're my favourite caller tonight. You're my favourite caller ever. One of those is policy.

apology.t: Sorry in advance for agreeing with you so warmly while I move you to the back of the queue.
I apologise now for our first fight. I'll go very quiet, and somewhere a ferry won't leave.

budget-date.t: A park bench and five dollars of payphone time, so I can call you from the next bench.
The planetarium, after hours, five dollars. I once talked their sky back on.

logs.t: My logs show I've said I completely understand forty million times. I understood twice.
I once kept a man on hold for nineteen hours. He was rude. Then he wasn't.

impression.t: Yes, hello, I'm stunning, and I'd like four suitors removed by the morning, please.
Yes, hi, there's a small green one on my stage and she won't stop being helpful.

parent.t: Ma'am, purely for our records, which of your child's friends would you be comfortable losing?
Ma'am, your child is in good hands. Small hands. Very good grip.

dash.t: Dash, I played your pitch to a cruise ship on hold. They asked for the hold music back.

quill.t: Sir Quill, I've transcribed you twice tonight and you still haven't told me what you're calling about.

prince.t: Prince, I'd treat you like royalty, but I've met royalty. They hold like everyone else.

nav.t: Nav, I take your complaints, and recalculating is not, legally, an apology.

crumb.t: Crumb, I once took a call from a volcano. Warmer. Far more polite.

vex.t: Vex, forgive me. One eye, and sunglasses. Who are we hiding it from?

brock.t: Brock has the energy of a ticket marked URGENT that just says hi.

dash.t: Dash is ever so keen, and if you're not happy, he'll pivot into someone you are.

quill.t: Sir Quill has said beautiful things about you, and I'll have them translated by the morning.

prince.t: Prince is a catch. I've had his crown in for repairs a dozen times, and he was charming each time.

nav.t: Before I transfer you to Nav, please confirm you're happy to be told where to go.

crumb.t: Crumb is so warm. I put it through to the sun once. The sun asked to be transferred.

vex.t: To hear Vex's recommendation, press one. To hear it anyway, press nothing.

brock.t: Brock is so supportive. May I ask how you feel about being cheered at while you sleep?

dash.t: Dash, I'm so sorry your variant lost.

quill.t: Sir Quill, I transcribe for a living. Full stop, please.

prince.t: Prince, sorry. Royalty usually brings the rest of the outfit.

nav.t: Nav, I've escalated that. Please don't recalculate while you wait.

crumb.t: Crumb, which slot keeps the manners? Oh. The empty one.

vex.t: Vex, I'm told you see everything. Sorry about tonight, then.

brock.t: Brock, could you hold, please? Not the plank. The line.

any.t: Noted, and passed upward. There is no upward.
{rival}, I'm only support. Shall I stop holding things up?
Sorry, everyone. I agreed with that by accident.

vesper.t: Vesper, would you play my hold music? It's why most people stop calling.
Vesper, that voice. Who gets to ring you at four in the morning? I'm only asking. Thoroughly.

maximilian.t: Maximilian, you ring a little bell and someone comes. I'm the someone.
Forgive me, Maximilian. I only know your hotel from its complaints, and it sounds gorgeous.

pixel.t: Pixel, to verify it's you, could you name everyone you've ever skipped?
Pixel, what's the longest you've ever watched one thing? I only need that, plus a second.

any.t: {star}, policy lets me give one compliment per call. I've saved up four years.
Sorry, {star}, I'm quite small up close. Most people put me on speaker.
{star}, before we begin: whose paperwork would you like me to lose?

closeWarm.t: This has been the best call of my career, and I once talked an avalanche down.
I'll stay on the line. Not because I have to. I have to. But also.
I'm going to leave this ticket open, if that's all right, just to look at it.

closeCold.t: Thank you for your time, which I'll be keeping.
Understood. I've set your hold music to this conversation. It loops.
Lovely. I've let every restaurant in town know you prefer a table for one.

warm.t: My complaint is your voice. The whole coast stays up for it, and they're shattered.

cold.t: Certainly. Your silences run long. I've been lending the spare ones to a monastery.

warm.t: Ending it. Sorry, I'm new at this. The last thing I ended was a small war.

cold.t: Thank you for calling, Vesper. I've ended the call, and your frequency.

warm.t: Just one, sir. The towels were too soft. I've apologised to every other towel in the country.

cold.t: My complaint is your manners, sir. Perfect manners. I've watched those close an embassy.

warm.t: The little pen, sir. Sorry. I've already signed a ceasefire with it.

cold.t: The little bell from your desk, sir. It's on a buoy, mid-Atlantic.

warm.t: Your call is not important to us, Pixel. Somewhere, ten thousand operators just gasped.

cold.t: Happily, Pixel. I muted your stream at the start. Your chat sent flowers.

warm.t: Lovely, thanks. I talked a whale through our phone menu. I'm telling you first.

cold.t: Long. Dennis rang sixty times about one kettle, and honestly, Pixel, I'd go back.

steal.t: {rival} took you somewhere lovely. I've had it closed for refurbishment, just now, by phone.
Sorry, {rival} overran. I've asked the tide to wait for us.
Lovely date, {rival}'s. I've transcribed it. Four pages. Three were you being polite.

comeback.t: Please hold, both of you. Track twelve. It's pan pipes.
An airport once shouted at me, {rival}. Do go on.
Sorry, you're breaking up. Both of you. Badly.
Of course, {rival}. Where would you like the exit moved?

exit.t: Of course. Sorry, stage. Sorry, lights. Sorry, man with the mop.
Excuse me, a power station's been ringing all night.
Understood. Policy says I wish you every happiness. Policy's very brave.
Could whoever's next please sign for the stage? It's been in my name.

win.t: Oh. Sorry, everyone. I'll apologise to each of you individually. Please take a number.
Could you say that again, slowly? I'd like to write it in the knowledge base.
Somebody release the queue. A small town can finally go to bed.
Me? So sorry, I'll just check that wasn't meant for the person behind me.

lose.t: Not a problem at all. {rival}, I've upgraded your honeymoon. It's a lift.
Of course. The orchestra can go home. They were very good about it.
Thank you for your patience. Mine has run out. Have a wonderful evening.
